admission.justification: Install routing in application/runtime/install.py, owner/build checks in cli/shared_held_store_reconciliation.py, and receipt-locked settlement in cli/role_held_store.py safely reclaim legacy shared stores without breaking live lock exclusion.

applicability: runtime_install invoked with reconcile_shared_held_stores=True over shared workspace held-message stores.
conditions: Live reconciliation blocks if any running server reports a different loadedDigest or the serving digest is unknown.
Closed or host-confirmed archived/gone owners are settled with waiting text recorded before removing the store and obsolete lock; live, unknown, or ambiguous owners are preserved and named.
exclusions: Default runtime_install leaves reconcile_shared_held_stores=False and does not touch shared stores.

evidence: The Worker freeze report binds focused verification on this tree.

statement: Opt-in runtime installation settles closed shared stores and names preserved owners, and removes obsolete store locks only after older writers are gone.
title: Opt-in runtime_install settles closed shared stores after old writers stop
